summary: Iter39 end-to-end tested Gemini 3.8 Flash RAG AI Chat for students (backend + frontend) against preview URL. Backend pytest 19/19 passed in /app/backend/tests/test_ai_rag_chat.py covering: (a) RBAC on /api/super-admin/ai-references GET/POST/DELETE - unauth 401/403, student 403, admin_provinsi 403, only super_admin allowed; (b) Upload validation - .exe unsupported ext rejected 400, empty file rejected 400 (oversize >20MB path exercised via 20MB boundary in code, tested with 0-byte); (c) Valid DOCX upload with unique marker BAJUKAWANRUBIKON<UUID> indexed with chunk_count>=1; POST response and GET list both hide storage_path; (d) Student AI chat security - unauth 401/403, admin_provinsi 403 on both /api/student/ai-chat/messages and /api/student/ai-chat/stream; (e) Grounded RAG SSE - streaming produced text deltas and a done event with sources=[<uploaded doc filename>] when question matched the indexed marker; (f) Out-of-scope: unrelated cooking question produced exact fallback 'Maaf, pertanyaan tersebut berada di luar cakupan referensi dokumen yang tersedia.' with sources=[]; (g) Session isolation - freshly-registered second student has a different session_id and message IDs disjoint from demo student's history; (h) Delete - admin cannot delete, super_admin delete returns 200 then subsequent delete 404. Frontend Playwright: Super Admin -> menu-ai-referensi shows ai-reference-manager, ai-reference-upload-input, ai-reference-list all present. Student demo login: student-ai-chat-widget renders at bottom-left (x=20, bottom=20 -> box y=1004 within 1080 vp); clicking student-ai-chat-open-button opens the panel with student-ai-chat-drag-handle, student-ai-chat-input, student-ai-chat-messages testids; pointer-drag on the drag-handle moved the widget by >200px (draggable OK); sending an out-of-scope question streamed the exact fallback sentence via SSE and it rendered inside student-ai-chat-messages. At 390x844 the student dashboard has document.scrollWidth-clientWidth=0 (no horizontal overflow) - Live Chat min-w-0 regression fix verified indirectly on the student side. Full cleanup verified via mongosh: ai_references=0, ai_reference_chunks=0, student_ai_chat_messages=0, test_iter39 users=0.

issues: Widget position state does not clamp to viewport on window resize/rotation. If a user drags the widget to left>=32px on desktop and then rotates to mobile, part of the 358px-wide panel can render off-screen (fixed-positioned so no horizontal page overflow occurs, so scrollWidth check still returns 0, but the widget itself is partially clipped). Consider clamping position.left to Math.min(position.left, window.innerWidth - widgetWidth - 8) on resize/open.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Clamp StudentAiChatWidget position on window resize / initial open so a previously-dragged x doesn't push the widget off-screen at 390px viewport.

OPTIONAL: In /api/super-admin/ai-references POST, if put_object() succeeds but text extraction fails (raise HTTPException 422 at line 6168) or chunks is empty (422 at 6171), the object stored in Emergent Object Storage is orphaned since no metadata is written. Consider try/except to skip storing until after extraction succeeds, or add a compensating no-op record so it can be identified for cleanup.
OPTIONAL: Consider returning 201 Created on successful POST /api/super-admin/ai-references (currently 200).
OPTIONAL: retrieve_ai_reference_chunks() loads ALL chunks into memory (to_list(5000)) and ranks in Python. Will not scale beyond a few hundred references; consider Mongo text index + $text search.
critical_code_review_comments: rag_service.extract_reference_text handles pdf/docx/xls/xlsx natively but for images/audio falls through to Gemini file extraction - good. However pypdf can raise on encrypted PDFs; wrap in explicit try to surface a clean 422.

server.py POST /api/super-admin/ai-references writes to object storage BEFORE extracting text; on extraction failure the stored blob is orphaned (no way to delete via Emergent Object Storage). Consider extracting FIRST, then storing only on success. This aligns with problem statement note about no deletion API.

SSE endpoint /api/student/ai-chat/stream returns 200 with StreamingResponse; on internal exception it swallows and emits OUT_OF_SCOPE - user-friendly but hides real errors from logs (they are only surfaced by 'except Exception:'). Consider logging.exception inside except branch for observability.

session_id = 'student-rag-' + user_id is deterministic per student. Good for isolation. History is capped to 40 messages via to_list(40) but not truncated in DB - long-lived students will accumulate chat rows forever; consider TTL or LRU trimming.
GEMINI_MODEL='gemini-3.8-flash' is hardcoded in rag_service.py; user-provided key is loaded from GEMINI_API_KEY env - matches spec.

StudentAiChatWidget.jsx: fetch() to /api/student/ai-chat/stream uses localStorage token; if token expires mid-stream nothing invalidates the widget UI. Consider handling 401 in the SSE fetch response.
AiReferenceManager.jsx toast.error(error.response?.data?.detail) is used for both list and delete failures - good UX, but no retry/backoff.
server.py is now ~6421 lines; modularization still recommended (carry-over from iter37/38).
SSE per-event flush is fine but there is no heartbeat/keep-alive; long Gemini think-times could cause proxy timeouts.

success_rate.frontend: 100% functional (all required testids + flows verified); 1 minor position-clamp UX note

test_credentials: Used demo accounts from /app/memory/test_credentials.md verbatim. Second-student flow registered an ephemeral test_iter39_<uuid>@example.com via /api/auth/register and torn down.
seed_data_creation: Per-run ephemeral: 1 DOCX reference (TEST_iter39_<hex>.docx containing unique marker BAJUKAWANRUBIKON<UUID>) uploaded via super_admin API, chunk indexed, then deleted through DELETE /api/super-admin/ai-references. 1 disposable student account registered and its chat history removed. UI Playwright fired 1 out-of-scope student question producing 2 chat rows on demo student session, both purged via mongosh at end. Final Mongo state verified: ai_references=0, ai_reference_chunks=0, student_ai_chat_messages=0, test_iter39 users=0. Note: 1 object storage blob (from the docx upload) remains reachable only if its UUID id was captured before delete - metadata was removed so it is unreachable per spec.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Rerun: MONGO_URL=mongodb://localhost:27017 DB_NAME=test_database python -m pytest backend/tests/test_ai_rag_chat.py -o addopts='' -v --junitxml=test_reports/pytest/iter39_ai_rag.xml. If Live Chat 390 admin overflow (from iter38) needs verifying again, on 390px the sidebar drawer's Live Chat entry can scroll off-screen; use page.evaluate('window.scrollTo(0, 500)') or set a taller viewport width when clicking mobile-menu-live-chat. Widget position state resets to (20,20) on fresh page load - so widget_390_within only fails if the drag test ran within the same session before resize; not a real UX bug for real users unless they resize the browser after dragging.
rca of the issue: No critical bugs. Only optional refinements: (1) StudentAiChatWidget stores {left,bottom} in local state without clamping on resize -> could partially clip on rotation from desktop to mobile mid-session. Mitigation: add a useEffect on window.resize that sets left = Math.min(prev.left, window.innerWidth - widgetWidth - 8). (2) put_object() runs before Gemini extraction so a 422 leaves an orphaned object storage blob since Emergent Object Storage has no deletion API. Mitigation: extract text first, only put_object on success. Repro (1): login demo student on 1920px, drag widget to right side, resize window to 390px width -> widget right edge > viewport width. Repro (2): upload a valid extension file whose content Gemini cannot parse (e.g., a corrupted .png) -> 422 returned but blob is stored.
